## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated, and the test suite passes locally
- [ ] Lint and format pass (for example `uv run ruff check .` and `uv run ruff format --check .`)
- [ ] No data files, credentials, tokens, keys, or private data are committed (check `git diff --stat` and the full diff)
- [ ] Results are reproducible: commands, seeds, data versions, and commit are recorded
- [ ] Negative or null results are kept and reported, not deleted or hidden
- [ ] Data sources are used within their terms, with any required attribution
